title: Software Engineer
description: Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us. Job Description Itron Resiliency Solutions is an innovative business unit within Itron focused on solving mission critical problems for utilities through software and AI. Resiliency Solutions offers unique, market leading solutions for front-line worker safety, storm response, excavation damage prevention, construction management, and many more. These software and AI solutions solve end-to-end challenges for the utilities that power our society and are used by the largest and most complex organizations in the world such as National Grid, Southern Company, and Exelon. Itron Resiliency Solutions is a global, diverse team of builders and innovators who tackle previously impossible challenges for our customers. If you have a desire to challenge yourself, solve impactful problems, and work with a passionate and talented team, this is the place. The Emergency Preparedness & Response (EP&R) team builds the systems that keep critical operations running when it matters most. When storms and severe weather threaten communities and infrastructure across the US, our platform enables customers to rapidly procure, mobilize, and manage the workforce needed to respond to and recover from storm damage — often under tight timelines and high-stakes conditions. We are looking for a Principal Engineer who is deeply hands-on, works backward from customer pain points and business needs, and measures success by impact rather than lines of code shipped. You will be the technical anchor of the team: a backend-heavy full-stack engineer who knows our systems inside and out, reasons rigorously about trade-offs, and raises the engineering bar for everyone around you while leading the team toward outcomes that genuinely matter. About the role We're hiring a Software Engineer in Bengaluru to build and run production services. You'll own features end to end — from understanding the problem to shipping, monitoring and fixing what you built — with growing independence and support from senior engineers. Our India engineering team is taking full ownership of core products and growing quickly, including a ground-up rebuild of a customer-critical service. You'll work closely with senior engineers, your Engineering Manager, Product and Customer Support. What you'll own in your first year Own: Own features and services end to end with speed and quality — build, test, release, monitor, fix. Well-scoped problems, then bigger ones. Start with clearly defined work and grow into breaking down ambiguous problems yourself. Design. Write design notes for your features and get them reviewed; contribute to larger designs led by senior engineers. Quality. Write tests, add observability, and take part in on-call so issues are caught before customers see them. Customers. Understand who uses what you build, and learn from support issues what to fix next. Code reviews. Give and receive thoughtful reviews, and help onboard engineers who join after you. What you must bring These are the bar. We can't teach them on the job. Experience: 1–4 years building production software. We level on demonstrated scope, not years alone. You've shipped code that runs in production. Features or services you built, released and supported — not only coursework or prototypes. You are strong at problem solving. You can take an unfamiliar, feature-sized problem, reason through it, and land on a simple, correct solution. You work independently toward a clear goal. Given a clear goal, you figure out the steps, unblock yourself, and ask for help at the right moments. We care how you engineer more than which language you did it in. Technical background You've built production software with a modern stack, such as: Cloud: hands-on with AWS — you've deployed and debugged services running on it. Languages: strong in at least one modern language such as Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript. Frameworks: modern service frameworks such as FastAPI, Node.js or equivalents. Databases: solid data modeling and query fundamentals — you can design a schema, use indexes well, and explain why a query is slow and how you'd fix it. Fundamentals: data structures, API design, and the basics of caching and concurrency. Exact tools matter less than depth. Strong experience on an equivalent stack is welcome. What sets great candidates apart Impact you can explain. You can say what changed because of something you built — for users, performance or reliability. One problem you went deep on. A bug, a performance issue or a design where you dug past the surface to understand why. Ownership beyond the ticket. You've fixed what you shipped when it broke, and improved it after release without being asked. Framework mindset: You notice repeated code and turn it into something reusable. Learning speed. You've picked up a new domain, codebase or technology quickly and delivered in it. Curiosity about the user. You've asked why a requirement exists, or suggested a simpler way to solve the user's problem. What we look for in everyone we hire Whatever the role, we hire for six things. Customer obsession. You care who uses what you build and whether it actually helped them. Impact over activity. You measure success by outcomes, not tickets closed or lines written. Honesty. You're specific about your own part in team work, raise problems early, and say what didn't work. Independence. You don't wait to be told every next step. You figure things out with little hand-holding. You will work with leaders who will partner with you in the journey. Passion. Not the word on a resume — the evidence: a side project, a technology you went deep on, something you built because you wanted to. Depth. At least one thing you've built or debugged that you can explain down to the internals and the tradeoffs. Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for! The successful candidate's starting wage will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience. Itron is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you require an accommodation to apply, please contact a recruiting representative at 1-800-635-5461 or email Accessibility@itron.com. Itron is transforming how the world manages energy, water and city services. Our trusted intelligent infrastructure solutions help utilities and cities improve efficiency, build resilience and deliver safe, reliable and affordable service. With edge intelligence, we connect people, data insights and devices so communities can better manage the essential resources they rely on to live. Join us as we create a more resourceful world: www.itron.com

title: SRE/ DevOps Engineer
description: We are looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE). The ideal candidate will be passionate about building highly reliable, scalable, and observable platforms while driving operational excellence across Azure-based GCP services. In this role, you will own service reliability, observability, incident management, and automation initiatives. You will work closely with development, platform, and operations teams to improve service availability, reduce operational toil, and enhance customer experience through proactive monitoring and reliability engineering practices. Key Responsibilities Service Reliability- Define and manage Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and Error Budgets to ensure platform reliability and customer satisfaction. Observability & Monitoring- Design and implement monitoring, alerting, and observability solutions for business-critical applications and services. ELK Stack Administration- Configure and manage Elasticsearch, Logstash, and Kibana (ELK) for log ingestion, analytics, troubleshooting, and operational insights. Dashboard Development- Create availability, uptime, performance, capacity, and health dashboards with meaningful KPIs and service metrics. Azure Operations- Support and optimize Azure services including AKS, IoT Hub, Event Hub, Azure Firewall, Application Gateway, and Azure networking components. Incident Management- Lead Major Incident (Sev1/Sev2) calls, drive incident response, coordinate stakeholders, and ensure rapid service restoration. KPI & SLA Governance- Track and improve operational KPIs such as Service Availability, MTTR, MTBF, Incident Resolution Time, and Alert Effectiveness. Root Cause Analysis- Conduct detailed RCA investigations and drive corrective and preventive actions to eliminate recurring issues. Automation & Reliability Engineering- Develop automation and self-healing solutions to reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency. Capacity & Performance Management- Monitor platform performance, forecast capacity needs, and recommend scalability improvements. Operational Excellence- Develop runbooks, operational procedures, and best practices aligned with SRE principles and industry standards. Cross-Functional Collaboration- Partner with Engineering, DevOps, Security, and Architecture teams to improve platform resilience and operational maturity. Required Skills & Qualifications SRE Practices- Strong understanding of SLI, SLO, SLA, Error Budgets, Reliability Engineering, and Site Reliability best practices. ELK Stack- Hands-on expertise in Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana, log ingestion pipelines, dashboard creation, alerting, and advanced log analytics. Azure Cloud- Strong operational knowledge of Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure IoT Hub, Azure Event Hub, Azure Firewall, Application Gateway, Azure Monitor, and Log Analytics. Incident Management- Proven experience driving major incident response, stakeholder communications, escalation management, and post-incident reviews. KPI Management- Ability to define, measure, and improve operational KPIs aligned with reliability and availability objectives. Containers & Kubernetes- Hands-on experience managing containerized workloads and Kubernetes environments at scale. Automation & Scripting- Proficiency in Python, PowerShell, Bash, or Shell scripting for operational automation. Monitoring & Observability- Experience with monitoring tools such as ELK, Azure Monitor, Grafana, Prometheus, Dynatrace, or similar platforms. Cloud Networking- Strong understanding of DNS, Load Balancers, Application Gateways, Firewalls, Virtual Networks, and network troubleshooting. Troubleshooting- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills across infrastructure, platform, and application layers. Communication- Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams.

description: Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us. About the role We're hiring a Technical Support Specialist in Bengaluru to be the technical line of support between our customers and engineering. Our software helps US electric utilities prepare for and respond to emergencies like major storms — when it doesn't work, crews and the public feel it. You'll take escalated issues, find out what's really going on, fix what you can, and hand engineering a clean, well-diagnosed problem when you can't. You'll work closely with our customer support team, engineers, Product and your manager, and help shape how support runs as we grow. What you'll own in your first year Own: Own escalated customer issues end to end — triage, reproduce, diagnose, resolve or hand off, and close the loop with the customer. Diagnose. Dig into logs, data and configuration to find the real cause, not just the symptom. Clean escalations. When engineering needs to fix something, hand over a reproducible issue with evidence, impact and priority — so it gets fixed fast. Storm-ready. Be ready for peak events, when customers lean on us hardest, and keep calm and clear communication flowing. Fix the pattern. Spot recurring issues, write knowledge-base articles and runbooks, and push for product fixes that remove whole categories of tickets. Voice of the customer. Bring what you learn from customers back to Product and Engineering so it shapes what we build next. What you must bring These are the bar. We can't teach them on the job. Experience: 3–4 years in technical support, application support or production support for a software product. You troubleshoot from evidence. You've diagnosed real production issues using logs, SQL and APIs — not only scripts and FAQs. You write clearly. Your tickets, customer updates and escalations are short, precise and easy to act on, for both customers and engineers. You stay calm under pressure. You've handled urgent, high-visibility issues and kept customers informed while you worked them. You work with minimal handholding. You take an issue, work it to the end, and know when and how to escalate. Availability: comfortable working hours that overlap with US customers. Sense of Urgency : Knows the importance of resolving customer issue asap or knowns when to escalate and when to protect engineering Team Bandwidth. We care how you solve problems more than which ticketing tool you used. Technical background You've supported web-based software running in the cloud, with hands-on skills such as: SQL: you write queries confidently to investigate data issues and verify fixes. APIs: you can call and debug REST APIs with tools such as Postman or curl, and read request and response payloads. Logs and monitoring: you've searched logs and dashboards in tools such as CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk or Kibana to trace an issue. Cloud: working knowledge of AWS or another cloud — enough to understand where a service runs and what can fail. Scripting: basic Python, Bash or similar to automate checks and repetitive fixes. Support tooling: ticketing and incident tools such as Jira, Zendesk, Freshdesk or PagerDuty, and the discipline of SLAs and priorities. Exact tools matter less than depth. Strong experience on an equivalent stack is welcome. What sets great candidates apart Impact you can explain. Resolution time went down, escalations to engineering dropped, or a recurring issue disappeared — and you can say what you did. A hard case, told in detail. An issue others gave up on that you traced to its root cause across logs, data and code. Ticket killers. You've turned repeat issues into a runbook, a script, a KB article or a product fix, so they stopped coming in. Incident experience. You've been part of a major outage or peak event and helped keep customers informed while it was fixed. Trusted by engineers. Developers took your escalations seriously because your diagnosis was usually right. What we look for in everyone we hire Whatever the role, we hire for six things. Customer obsession. You treat every ticket as a customer who can't do their job, and you follow up until it's actually solved. Impact over activity. You measure success by problems solved and tickets prevented, not tickets touched. Honesty. You tell customers what you know and what you don't, never promise what engineering hasn't committed, and own your mistakes. Independence. You don't wait to be told what to do next. You work an issue to the end with little hand-holding. You will work with leaders who will partner with you in the journey. Passion. Not the word on a resume — the evidence: a tool you built to make support faster, a product you learned inside out, things you taught others. Depth. At least one product you've supported well enough to explain how it works under the hood and where it usually breaks. Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. Implement and maintain firewall, remote access, IDS/IPS, micro-segmentation, identity and access, secret management, hardening, vulnerability-remediation, and zero-trust controls. About the job Google Cloud's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems. Design and develop high-throughput, low-latency control-plane software for Cloud Interconnect, Cloud VPN, and Cloud Router. Translate product requirements into technical designs, ensuring seamless integration with Google Cloud's hybrid networking infrastructure. Diagnose control-plane issues across distributed routing and virtual private network systems. Enhance observability, sub-second route convergence, fault tolerance, and system uptime to maintain enterprise-grade Service-Level Agreements (SLAs). Partner with Product Management, SRE, and partner engineering teams across global and local Bengaluru sites to align on technical dependencies and deliver high-performance hybrid connectivity solutions. Write clean and maintainable code in C++, Go, or Python. Streamline control-plane testing and operational workflows while mentoring engineers.
